relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: individuals with Nav1.7 loss-of-function mutations are congenitally insensitive to acute and chronic pain

key_findings: Nav1.7, Nav1.8 and Nav1.9 are important in peripheral pain signalling; Nav1.7 loss of function causes congenital insensitivity to pain.
Drugs phenocopying Nav1.7 loss of function will likely need to be brain-penetrant.
